nodes.label: User journeys: 5 journeys, 10 design principles
nodes.rationale: Onboarding under 3 minutes, Marcus daily, Priya hotel lobby under 30 seconds, Elena dark morning, Jake plan repair. Principles: explain reasoning, degrade honestly, never promise safe, free path always works.

nodes.label: Design principle: degrade honestly, never fake confidence, never promise safe
nodes.rationale: Safety-aware is the ceiling of the claim; banned-terms linter in CI; the honest refusal is a trust moment.
